name: easeupmush
description: Ease Up Mush — hand-drawn browser games from the South Coast.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @easeupmush/site && GAME_BASE=/games/pompey-punch-up/ npm run build -w @easeupmush/pompey-punch-up && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
scripts.site: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
